role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 原初力量的细小碎片，与遗迹们系出同源，天穹守望者泽特誓将见证天辉和夜魇大战的终结。操控乱流能量突袭落单的敌人，或者扭曲空间，制造力场保护盟友。召唤闪光幽魂来回萦绕，摧残踏足的敌人，然后创造泽特的复制体，控制所有的物品和技能，将众敌全数碾压。
hero_summary_en: A splintered fragment of the same primordial power as the Ancients themselves, Zet the Arc Warden has pledged to see the clash between Radiant and Dire finally end. Assault lone enemies with fluxing energy, or distort space to generate a protective field around allies. Summon a Spark Wraith to patrol an area for enemies to infuse with harmful magic, then create a double of Zet, items and all, to overwhelm your foes.

abilities.name: arc_warden_flux
abilities.description_zh: 将不稳定的涡流能量灌注到落单敌人体内，造成持续伤害并减缓其移动速度。如目标周围有其他敌方单位 ，则不会造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Infuses a lone enemy unit with swirling, volatile energy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target. The damage is not applied if another enemy unit is near the target.

scepter_loc.en: Flux silences when the target is alone, deals more damage, and lasts longer.
scepter_loc.zh: 目标落单时乱流具有沉默效果，造成更高伤害，而且持续时间更长。

abilities.name: arc_warden_magnetic_field
abilities.description_zh: 天穹守望者制造一个充满磁能的圆形扭曲力场。磁场提供攻击速度加成，并且其中的友方单位可以闪避来自磁场外的攻击。磁场可以牵引神符，并且自动激活其中的神符。
abilities.description_en: Arc Warden generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy. The Magnetic Field grants bonus attack speed and protects allied units within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field. The Magnetic Field pulls runes, and runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.
facet_text_en: Magnetic Field pulls runes. Runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.
facet_text_zh: 磁场会牵引神符。磁场内的神符会自动激活。

abilities.name: arc_warden_spark_wraith
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一个缓慢实体化的闪光怨灵萦绕在目标区域，直到有敌人进入范围。一旦有敌方单位进入范围，怨灵将贴近敌人自我熔化，造成魔法伤害并使目标减速。
abilities.description_en: Summons a Spark Wraith that slowly materializes and patrols a targeted area until an enemy comes within its range. Once a target has been found the wraith fuses with them, dealing magical damage and slowing the unit.
notes_en: Spark Wraiths can not be disjointed.

abilities.name: arc_warden_runic_infusion
abilities.description_zh: 神符之力与本尊融合。天穹守望者或风暴双雄每次激活强化神符后天穹守望者都会永久获得+%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% 全属性。
abilities.description_en: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.
facet_text_en: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.
facet_text_zh: 神符之力与本尊融合。天穹守望者或风暴双雄每次激活强化神符后天穹守望者都会永久获得+%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% 全属性。

abilities.name: arc_warden_tempest_double
abilities.description_zh: 天穹守望者将破碎的自我汇聚到一起，创造出自身的完美电子复制体。复制体可以使用天穹守望者的当前所有物品和基础技能，但是大部分消耗品以及死亡时会掉落的物品除外。复制体的物品和技能冷却时间会独立计算。复制体会逐渐失去自我意识，移动速度变慢，攻击准确度下降。
abilities.description_en: Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.
notes_zh: 复制体无法使用风暴双雄或刷新球。
notes_en: Tempest Double and Refresher Orb cannot be used by the duplicate.

shard_loc.en: The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.Does not trigger Runic Infusion.
shard_loc.zh: 风暴双雄产生时带有奥术、隐身和极速神符的效果，持续%rune_duration%秒。不会触发神符灌注。

facet_text_en:
The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Power Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.

Level 1 - Arcane Rune.

Level 2 - Arcane and Invisibility Runes.

Level 3 - Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes.
facet_text_zh:
风暴双雄产生时带有强化神符的加成效果，持续%rune_duration%秒。

1级 - 奥术神符。

2级 - 奥术和隐身神符。

3级 - 奥术、隐身和极速神符。
